description: Gate C W2 (Round Board — Planning and Allocation: C04 planning-open, C05 planning-closed/mixed-boundary, C06 dense-allocation) UI Lab visual-review evidence SECOND REMEDIATION PASS. A second independent review of PR #829 (last reviewed HEAD af686e3cd8cf0a0633f18d931bb47bf7a6eca590) found the first remediation pass's Resolve-eligibility and source-boundary fixes (P1-01/P1-03) were still incomplete, plus two further defects: Resolve eligibility did not check the signal's own player's current match; match-specific Resolve had no effective desktop behavior; the mixed-boundary banner claimed every match was closed when only some were; the desktop Move picker still offered closed destinations. All four are fixed in this pass. This evidence supersedes the prior commit's evidence for every scenario whose rendering changed: C05's primary route (the banner wording, the new move-picker-excludes-closed interaction state) and the new C05 open-match-warning route (match-specific Resolve's real desktop effect). C04 and C06 are unaffected by this pass's fixes but are included for completeness since the whole wave is captured in one CI run. See docs/ui-lab/gate-c-w2-candidates/REVIEW_RECORD.md for the full finding-by-finding disposition.
knownLimitations: sourceCommitSha above is the GitHub Actions pull_request-trigger synthetic merge commit (base main + this PR head, confirmed via the checkout step's own log: "Merge b6b845857a0fc819d6ab058a73b3244d61160848 into 8849c6dac5cd6e9da8c1a2c6e30dfb63320cf2b0"), not the branch-tip commit — same precedent as every prior wave. reviewedBranchHeadSha above is this PR's own real branch-tip commit at the time of this run (the second remediation pass's final commit, b6b84585).
GitHub Actions artifact retention is temporary (expires 2026-11-22) — a durable GitHub Release has not been attempted, same disclosed gap as every prior wave.

All 110 Gate C W2 hashes recorded below were independently re-verified in this session: all 110 files were downloaded via `gh run download 43734288673` and every SHA-256 recomputed from the raw bytes with `sha256sum` — zero mismatches against the CI job's own self-reported per-file sha256 log lines.

The first push of this pass's fixes (commit cdc2c4bd8349640a60abeeeacb0595b6be2a2119) crashed the capture job entirely with an uncaught TimeoutError before producing any usable artifact — a new capture-script interaction clicked a button genuinely absent from the accessibility tree below the desktop breakpoint on mobile viewports. That run (43732030847) is NOT the source of this evidence; it produced no complete, usable capture set and is not referenced as evidence anywhere. This attestation's evidence is exclusively from the corrected re-run (43734288673, commit b6b845857) after the capture script was fixed and re-verified locally.

This is the second capture run whose evidence is retained for Gate C W2. The first remediation pass's own run (completed-run 43701980427, commit af686e3cd) is superseded for C05's primary route (banner wording changed; a new move-picker-excludes-closed interaction state was added) and for the new C05 open-match-warning route (did not exist in that pass). C04 and C06's own rendering is unchanged by this pass's fixes, but this attestation covers the same revision as the production fix commit regardless, so it is the current evidence for all four routes uniformly.

This same CI run also executed 98 real Chromium Playwright tests (e2e/ui-lab-gate-c.spec.ts, project `ui-lab-gate-c`) — the 93 tests carried over from the first remediation pass and prior waves, plus 2 new tests proving this pass's match-specific-Resolve-on-desktop and Move-picker-excludes-closed fixes in a real browser — plus 54 B08 Playwright tests, all passing, matching the local pre-push run exactly.
